card.name: End page digits in citations
card.fires_on: Digits of the ending page number in a reference's page range, right after the dash following the starting page. Seen in journal citations with year, volume and pages.

modes.label: Ending page digit
modes.description: A digit in the second number of a page range in a journal reference.
modes.example: Int J Antimicrob Agents. 2005;25:68–<<7>>4. - Stratchounski LS

modes.label: Later digit of end page
modes.description: A middle digit of the end page where the range repeats the start digits.

card.plain: It lights up on the digits of the last page number in a journal citation's page range.
